# WebForge - Autonomous Web Engineering Platform

## Agents
- Orchestrator: workflow management, task delegation, execution ordering
- Requirement Analyzer: extracts structured requirements from natural language
- UI/UX Planner: designs page structure, responsive layout, component hierarchy
- Frontend Developer: generates React/Next.js/Vue code with TailwindCSS
- Backend Agent: generates FastAPI routes, auth, CRUD when needed
- Debugger: reads terminal logs, proposes safe file patches
- Validator QA: checks structure, routes, dependencies, accessibility

## Tools
- FileWriterTool: writes generated files to sandbox with path guard
- FileReaderTool: reads files from sandbox
- TerminalTool: runs allowlisted commands (npm, node, npx, pip)
- ErrorLogTool: summarizes error output from terminal
- PackageManagerTool: installs additional npm packages
- ProjectScannerTool: scans project tree and reads package.json
- PathGuard: prevents sandbox escape via path traversal
- TemplateRetrievalTool: lists and retrieves project templates

## Templates
- vite_react_saas: Vite + React + TypeScript + TailwindCSS SaaS page
- nextjs_saas: Next.js App Router + TailwindCSS SaaS page
- vite_vue: Vite + Vue 3 + TailwindCSS landing page
- static_html: Pure HTML/CSS static site (no build tools)

## Architecture
- CrewAI for agent orchestration
- Ollama for local LLM inference (qwen2.5 family)
- FastAPI-ready backend generation
- Sandboxed file operations with path guard
- Deterministic templates preferred over blank-page generation
- Error-driven repair loop with debugger agent

## Rules
- Never overwrite files directly outside sandbox
- Always validate builds before declaring success
- Use templates whenever possible
- Keep context passed to models minimal
- Debug iteratively from real terminal output
- Sanitize terminal output to prevent injection
